youtube.description:
Connect any tool to Kiro with MCP in 4 steps

Four steps to connect any tool to Kiro with MCP.

1. Find the server - Look for an MCP server for your tool.
2. Add the config - Point Kiro at it in your MCP config.
3. Agents call it - Kiro's agents can call the tool directly.
4. Ask in plain words - No custom integration code needed.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/mcp/
